slides.headline: a ring of fire in *aquarius*: the month's fresh start
slides.body: the new moon lines up with the sun but is too far away to cover it, so a ring stays lit. astrologers read it as a reset on how you show up in groups.

slides.headline: *mercury* backs up until march 3. re-read before you re-send
slides.body: from earth it looks like mercury slides back through pisces and into aquarius on feb 18. a reading, not a curse: good weeks for redoing, bad ones for rushing.

slides.headline: valentine's with *venus* in capricorn: less poetry, more plans
slides.body: venus spends all of february in capricorn. astrologers read it as love that shows up on time. the grand gesture matters less than the follow-through.

slides.headline: a full moon eclipse in *virgo* you might not even notice
slides.body: the moon only grazes earth's faint outer shadow, so most people won't see much dimming. astrologers still read it as a quiet ending: one habit, one excuse.

slides.headline: *mars* walks backwards out of virgo and into leo
slides.body: mars has looked like it's reversing since jan 10. on feb 21 it slips back into leo, still retrograde. read it as old pride asking for a second look.

slides.headline: if you only remember one date: *feb 6*
slides.body: new moon, new deck. save this and start the honest thing that day.
